summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Fleshsesh Academy AI Faculty Chat feature. All 27 backend tests pass (100%). Fixed auth loading race condition in FacultyChat.js that was causing redirect issues. Chat functionality fully working with real LLM integration (GPT-4o via emergentintegrations).

issues: Logo PNG shows checkered/transparent background pattern - image asset has transparency artifacts visible against dark background

Stats endpoint returns correct counts (28 lessons, 14 labs, 4 levels, 8 faculty)
